meaningEn: OMG!
exampleKo: 헐, 진짜? 그게 가능하다고? 대박이다!
exampleEn: OMG, really? That's possible? That's amazing!

meaningEn: Awesome!
exampleKo: 오늘 콘서트 진짜 대박이었어! 무대 연출 미쳤다!
exampleEn: Today's concert was seriously awesome! The stage production was insane!

meaningEn: That's insane!
exampleKo: 야, 저 영상 봤어? 진짜 미쳤다! 대박이야.
exampleEn: Hey, did you see that video? It's seriously insane! So amazing.

meaningEn: Is this for real?
exampleKo: 벌써 품절이라고? 실화냐? 나 아직 못 샀는데.
exampleEn: It's already sold out? Is this for real? I haven't bought it yet.

meaningEn: Legendary; an iconic moment or thing
exampleKo: 어제 우리 팀 경기 봤어? 마지막 골은 진짜 레전드였어.
exampleEn: Did you see our team's game yesterday? That last goal was truly legendary.

meaningEn: Agreed; Facts
exampleKo: 이거 진짜 맛있지 않아? ㅇㅈ? 완전 꿀맛이야.
exampleEn: Isn't this seriously delicious? Agreed? It's super yummy.

meaningEn: For real; Seriously
exampleKo: 오늘 날씨 ㄹㅇ 좋지 않아? 나들이 가고 싶다.
exampleEn: Isn't the weather seriously nice today? I want to go on a picnic.

meaningEn: Flawlessly perfect; Divinely perfect
exampleKo: 새로 나온 아이돌 앨범 들어봤어? 컨셉부터 갓벽이야.
exampleEn: Have you heard the new idol album? From the concept, it's flawlessly perfect.

meaningEn: A masterpiece; A classic
exampleKo: 이 웹툰 진짜 띵작이니까 꼭 봐봐! 후회 안 할 걸.
exampleEn: This webtoon is a real masterpiece, so definitely check it out! You won't regret it.

meaningEn: Super fun; A blast
exampleKo: 어제 친구들이랑 보드게임 했는데 완전 꿀잼이었어!
exampleEn: I played board games with friends yesterday and it was super fun!

meaningEn: Boring; No fun
exampleKo: 그 영화 너무 노잼이라 중간에 나왔어. 돈 아까워.
exampleEn: That movie was so boring I left halfway through. Such a waste of money.

meaningEn: That's dope/killer; Extremely impressive
exampleKo: 와, 저 사람 기타 연주하는 거 봤어? 진짜 쩐다!
exampleEn: Wow, did you see that person playing guitar? That's seriously dope!

meaningEn: Goosebumps; Chills
exampleKo: 그 노래 라이브로 들었는데 소오름 돋았어. 진짜 감동.
exampleEn: I heard that song live and got goosebumps. It was truly moving.

meaningEn: Woohoo!; Yippee! (A joyful cheer)
exampleKo: 드디어 금요일이다! 무야호! 주말에 뭐 할까?
exampleEn: It's finally Friday! Woohoo! What should we do this weekend?

meaningEn: None at all; Zero
exampleKo: 그 사람 말은 1도 안 믿겨. 다 거짓말 같아.
exampleEn: I don't believe a single word that person says. It all seems like lies.

meaningEn: An insider; A popular, socially active person
exampleKo: 그 친구는 완전 인싸라서 아는 사람이 진짜 많아.
exampleEn: That friend is a total social butterfly, they know so many people.

meaningEn: An outsider; A loner who keeps to themselves
exampleKo: 나는 집에서 혼자 노는 게 좋아서 아싸에 가까워.
exampleEn: I prefer playing alone at home, so I'm closer to being a loner.

meaningEn: A super-insider; An ultra-popular social butterfly
exampleKo: 우리 과에 핵인싸 한 명 있는데, 모르는 사람이 없어.
exampleEn: There's one super-insider in our major; everyone knows them.

meaningEn: Real; Genuine; The real deal
exampleKo: 그 사람은 찐팬이라서 굿즈도 엄청 많이 모았더라.
exampleEn: That person is a real fan, they collected so much merchandise.

meaningEn: Genuine excitement; Real, unforced high energy
exampleKo: 무대 위에서 아이돌들 찐텐으로 즐기는 모습 너무 보기 좋더라.
exampleEn: It was so great to see the idols genuinely enjoying themselves on stage with real high energy.

meaningEn: Max level; An expert who's totally mastered something
exampleKo: 와, 이 게임 벌써 만렙 찍었어? 너 진짜 만렙 능력자다!
exampleEn: Wow, you already reached max level in this game? You're a true master!

meaningEn: A super-capable, skilled person who gets things done
exampleKo: 우리 팀 막내가 사실 능력자였어. 일 처리 진짜 빨라.
exampleEn: Our team's youngest member was actually a super-capable person. They get things done really fast.

meaningEn: A 'god life'; A disciplined, productive, admirable lifestyle
exampleKo: 이번 년 목표는 갓생 살기야! 매일 운동하고 공부할 거야.
exampleEn: My goal this year is to live a 'god life'! I'm going to exercise and study every day.

meaningEn: The mood-maker; The life of the party
exampleKo: 우리 모임에는 항상 분위기 메이커가 있어야 더 재밌어.
exampleEn: Our gatherings are always more fun when there's a mood-maker.

meaningEn: Too much talker; Someone who talks excessively
exampleKo: 걔는 진짜 TMT라서 한번 말 시작하면 끝이 없어.
exampleEn: That person is a real TMT, once they start talking, there's no end.

meaningEn: Someone who already knows the answer they want to hear and just wants you to confirm it.
exampleKo: 야, 너 진짜 답정너다. 내가 뭐라고 대답해주길 바라는 거야?
exampleEn: Hey, you're such a 'dapjeongneo.' What answer do you want me to give you?

meaningEn: An attention-seeker; someone who craves attention.
exampleKo: 쟤 또 관종짓 하네. 관심받고 싶어서 안달났나봐.
exampleEn: There they go again, being an attention-seeker. They must be desperate for attention.

meaningEn: A 'professional complainer' or 'professional discomforter'; someone who easily finds things to be offended by or complain about.
exampleKo: 걔는 진짜 프로불편러야. 뭘 해도 다 불편해하는 것 같아.
exampleEn: They're a real 'professional complainer.' It seems like everything makes them uncomfortable.

meaningEn: Someone who has been single their entire life and has never dated anyone; a 'lifetime solo'.
exampleKo: 친구 중에 모쏠이 많아서 다 같이 솔로 파티했어.
exampleEn: I have a lot of friends who've never dated, so we all had a solo party together.

meaningEn: Someone who falls in love quickly and easily; a 'quick-to-fall-in-love person'.
exampleKo: 걔는 완전 금사빠라니까. 또 새로운 사람한테 푹 빠진 것 같아.
exampleEn: They're totally a 'quick-to-fall-in-love person.' It seems like they've fallen for someone new again.

meaningEn: Work-life balance; the state of having a healthy balance between work and personal life.
exampleKo: 요즘 회사 워라밸 너무 좋아서 행복해. 퇴근하고 바로 운동 가!
exampleEn: My company's work-life balance is so good these days, I'm happy. I go straight to work out after leaving work!

meaningEn: Value for money; bang for the buck, meaning good performance or quality relative to its price.
exampleKo: 이 식당 진짜 가성비 최고야. 맛도 좋고 양도 많아.
exampleEn: This restaurant offers amazing value for money. The food's good and the portions are big.

meaningEn: Value for emotional satisfaction; buying something that brings personal happiness or fulfillment, regardless of its objective cost-effectiveness.
exampleKo: 가심비 좋은 물건이라 비싸도 후회 안 해. 나한테 주는 선물이야.
exampleEn: It's a product with great emotional value, so I don't regret it even if it's expensive. It's a gift to myself.

meaningEn: Amazing, 'god-tier' value for money; exceptionally good performance or quality relative to its price.
exampleKo: 와, 이 노트북 갓성비 미쳤다! 이 가격에 이런 사양이라니.
exampleEn: Wow, this laptop has insane 'god-tier' value for money! These specs for this price?

meaningEn: An initialism used to declare 'today's workout done' or 'finished my workout for today,' often posted with a gym selfie.
exampleKo: 드디어 오운완! 힘들어 죽는 줄 알았어.
exampleEn: Finally, today's workout done! I thought I was going to die.

meaningEn: To flex; to splurge on something expensive and show it off, especially money or luxury items.
exampleKo: 오늘 월급 받아서 명품 가방 플렉스 했어!
exampleEn: I got paid today so I flexed with a luxury bag!

meaningEn: Scraping together every last penny or resource, often to make a significant purchase like a home or investment; 'soul-squeezing'.
exampleKo: 요즘 집 살 때 영끌해서 사는 게 기본이 되었어.
exampleEn: These days, when buying a house, it's become standard to gather every last penny.

meaningEn: A frugal money-saving lifestyle that involves being very stingy and creative with finances; 'stingy tech/finance'.
exampleKo: 나 요즘 짠테크 중이야. 한 푼이라도 아끼려고 노력하고 있어.
exampleEn: I'm doing 'stingy tech' these days. I'm trying to save every penny.

meaningEn: The fun or joy of blowing money on small, often unnecessary, everyday treats or impulse buys.
exampleKo: 소소하게 탕진잼 누리는 중. 이 맛에 돈 벌지!
exampleEn: I'm enjoying a little 'squandering fun'. This is why I earn money!

meaningEn: Money wasted due to one's own carelessness, forgetfulness, or poor judgment; a 'dumb tax'.
exampleKo: 어제 택시 타고 갔어야 했는데, 멍청비용 또 썼네.
exampleEn: I should've taken a taxi yesterday, but I spent 'dumb tax' again.

meaningEn: YOLO; You Only Live Once, an acronym used to justify enjoying the present moment and living life to the fullest, often involving spending.
exampleKo: 욜로! 일단 즐기고 보는 거지 뭐.
exampleEn: YOLO! Just enjoy it for now, you know?

meaningEn: Leaving work exactly on time, not a minute late; 'knife-like departure'.
exampleKo: 나 오늘 칼퇴하고 바로 약속 있어. 후딱 마무리해야지.
exampleEn: I have plans right after leaving work exactly on time today. Gotta finish quickly.

meaningEn: An initialism asking for a 'lunch menu recommendation'.
exampleKo: 얘들아, 오늘 점메추 좀! 뭐 먹을지 고민돼.
exampleEn: Guys, any lunch menu recommendations for today? I can't decide what to eat.

meaningEn: An initialism asking for a 'dinner menu recommendation'.
exampleKo: 퇴근하고 뭐 먹지? 저메추 해주라!
exampleEn: What should I eat after work? Recommend me a dinner menu!

meaningEn: Eating alone; solo dining.
exampleKo: 오늘 저녁은 혼밥할 건데, 맛집 추천해 줄 사람?
exampleEn: I'm eating alone for dinner tonight, anyone recommend a good restaurant?

meaningEn: Drinking alone; solo drinking.
exampleKo: 오늘 힘든 일이 있어서 집에서 혼술 좀 해야겠어.
exampleEn: I had a tough day today, so I think I need to drink alone at home.

meaningEn: An initialism for 'iced americano even if I freeze to death,' referring to someone who always drinks iced americano regardless of the weather.
exampleKo: 날씨 추운데도 얼죽아 정신으로 아이스 아메리카노 마셨어.
exampleEn: Even though the weather's cold, I drank an iced americano with that 'iced americano even if I freeze to death' spirit.

meaningEn: A great, handy, or extremely useful tip or piece of advice; a 'honey tip'.
exampleKo: 이거 진짜 꿀팁인데, 너한테만 알려주는 거야.
exampleEn: This is a real 'honey tip', I'm only telling you.

meaningEn: The universal rule everyone follows; an unspoken standard or common practice that's widely accepted; 'national rule'.
exampleKo: 떡볶이 먹을 땐 쿨피스 마시는 게 국룰 아니겠어?
exampleEn: Isn't it a 'national rule' to drink Coolpis when you eat tteokbokki?

meaningEn: A budding romance; the 'talking stage' or 'something' between two people who are interested in each other but not officially dating.
exampleKo: 쟤랑 나랑 요즘 썸 타는 중이야. 어떻게 될지 궁금하다.
exampleEn: We're in the 'talking stage' these days. I wonder what will happen.

meaningEn: To be in the early, flirty "talking stage" with someone; to have romantic chemistry with someone before officially dating.
exampleKo: 요즘 나 쟤랑 썸타는 것 같아! 우리 사귀게 될까?
exampleEn: I think I'm in the talking stage with them these days! Will we start dating?

meaningEn: Chemistry; great rapport or natural connection between two people, especially in a romantic or friendship context.
exampleKo: 와, 너네 둘이 케미 진짜 좋다! 완전 잘 어울려.
exampleEn: Wow, you two have great chemistry! You match so well.

meaningEn: The act of reading a message and intentionally not replying; to leave someone on read.
exampleKo: 걔 내 메시지 또 읽씹했어. 완전 얄밉다!
exampleEn: They left my message on read again. So annoying!

meaningEn: The act of not even opening a message and intentionally ignoring it; to completely ghost a message.
exampleKo: 얘가 내 톡을 아예 안읽씹하네. 진짜 너무한 거 아니야?
exampleEn: They're not even opening my message. Isn't that too much?

meaningEn: To cut someone off; to end a relationship (friendship, business, etc.) abruptly and completely to avoid further loss or hassle.
exampleKo: 걔 자꾸 나한테 피해만 줘서 결국 손절했어.
exampleEn: They kept causing me trouble, so I finally cut them off.

meaningEn: A double standard; "romance when I do it, an affair when others do it." Hypocrisy where one judges others by a stricter standard than oneself.
exampleKo: 자기 할 땐 괜찮고 남이 하면 안 된대. 완전 내로남불 아니야?
exampleEn: When they do it, it's fine, but when others do it, it's not. Isn't that a total double standard?

meaningEn: Know when to join in and when to back off; to "read the room" and act appropriately in social situations.
exampleKo: 야, 쟤는 진짜 낄끼빠빠를 너무 못해. 분위기 흐리네.
exampleEn: Hey, they really don't know when to join in and when to back off. They're ruining the mood.

meaningEn: Seeking natural encounters; preferring to meet people organically rather than through dating apps or arranged blind dates.
exampleKo: 나는 데이팅 앱보다 자만추가 더 좋아. 자연스러운 만남이 최고지.
exampleEn: I prefer natural encounters over dating apps. Natural meetings are the best.

meaningEn: A sudden awkward chill that kills the mood; when the atmosphere suddenly becomes cold or uncomfortable.
exampleKo: 걔 농담에 다들 갑분싸 됐어. 진짜 노잼이야.
exampleEn: Everyone went quiet after their joke. It really killed the mood.

meaningEn: It depends; case by case; meaning that the outcome or situation varies depending on the specific circumstances.
exampleKo: 그거 되는지 안 되는지는 케바케야. 상황마다 달라.
exampleEn: Whether that works or not is case by case. It varies with the situation.

meaningEn: It varies from person to person; meaning that preferences or outcomes differ depending on the individual.
exampleKo: 그 음식 맛은 사바사야. 어떤 사람은 좋아하고 어떤 사람은 싫어해.
exampleEn: The taste of that food varies from person to person. Some like it, some don't.

meaningEn: A shortened, casual greeting meaning "Nice to meet you, please take care of me well" or "Nice to meet you, let's get along."
exampleKo: 안녕! 새로 온 멤버야. 만반잘부~ 잘 지내보자!
exampleEn: Hi! I'm the new member. Nice to meet you, let's get along!

meaningEn: A request to "handle it well, neatly, and with good sense, on your own"; implying to take care of something skillfully and appropriately without needing detailed instructions.
exampleKo: 그 일은 네가 알잘딱깔센하게 처리해 줘. 믿는다!
exampleEn: Please handle that task well and smartly on your own. I trust you!

meaningEn: A playful, often dismissive "whatever, I don't care" or "so what?" brush-off, often used among friends.
exampleKo: 나 오늘 시험 망했어. 어쩔티비?
exampleEn: I bombed my test today. Whatever, don't care?

meaningEn: "You abbreviate literally everything"; a playful or exasperated remark about someone who shortens too many words or phrases.
exampleKo: 요즘 애들은 별다줄이야. 너무 줄임말 많이 써.
exampleEn: Kids these days abbreviate literally everything. They use too many acronyms.

meaningEn: "Let's go," "go go"; used to urge action or start something.
exampleKo: 야, 우리 피시방 ㄱㄱ?
exampleEn: Hey, wanna go to the PC bang? Let's go!

meaningEn: "Okay"; an informal acknowledgment or agreement.
exampleKo: 이따 저녁에 봐. ㅇㅋ?
exampleEn: See you later tonight. Okay?

meaningEn: "No no," "nope"; an informal refusal or disagreement.
exampleKo: 밥 먹었어? ㄴㄴ 아직.
exampleEn: Did you eat? Nope, not yet.

meaningEn: "Hi"; an informal greeting.
exampleKo: ㅎㅇ! 다들 잘 지냈어?
exampleEn: Hi! Has everyone been doing well?

meaningEn: "Bye bye"; an informal farewell.
exampleKo: 나 먼저 갈게. ㅂㅂ!
exampleEn: I'm gonna head out first. Bye bye!

meaningEn: "Thanks"; an informal expression of gratitude.
exampleKo: 도와줘서 ㄱㅅ! 다음에 내가 밥 살게.
exampleEn: Thanks for helping! I'll buy you a meal next time.

meaningEn: "Sorry"; an informal apology.
exampleKo: 늦어서 ㅈㅅ! 빨리 갈게.
exampleEn: Sorry for being late! I'll be there soon.

meaningEn: "Congrats"; an informal congratulation.
exampleKo: 시험 합격 ㅊㅋㅊㅋ! 정말 대단하다.
exampleEn: Congrats on passing the test! That's really amazing.

meaningEn: "Good work," "take care"; an informal way to acknowledge someone's effort or bid them farewell after work/effort.
exampleKo: 오늘 회의 준비하느라 ㅅㄱ 많았어!
exampleEn: You worked hard preparing for the meeting today! (or "Good job today!")

meaningEn: Too much information; used when someone shares excessive or unnecessary personal details.
exampleKo: 방금 내가 말한 거 혹시 TMI였어? 미안!
exampleEn: Was what I just said TMI? Sorry!

meaningEn: Chicken for dinner tonight?
exampleKo: 오늘 저녁 뭐 먹지? 오저치고 할래?
exampleEn: What should we eat tonight? Chicken for dinner tonight?

meaningEn: Suddenly checked my bank account and realized I need a part-time job.
exampleKo: 월급날 멀었는데 벌써 갑통알... 알바 찾아봐야겠다.
exampleEn: Payday is so far away, already checked my bank account and realized I need a part-time job... Gotta look for a gig.

meaningEn: A meme image or reaction picture, often used in texts or online.
exampleKo: 이 상황에 딱 맞는 짤이 있는데 보내줄게!
exampleEn: I have the perfect meme for this situation, I'll send it to you!

meaningEn: An animated GIF, a moving meme or reaction picture.
exampleKo: 와, 이 움짤 진짜 웃기다. 저장해서 친구들한테 보내야지.
exampleEn: Wow, this GIF is really funny. I should save it and send it to my friends.

meaningEn: Provocative bait or a troll post designed to stir reactions or attention online; 'aggro'.
exampleKo: 쟤 왜 자꾸 어그로 끌지? 그냥 무시하는 게 답이야.
exampleEn: Why does that person keep trying to bait people? The best response is just to ignore them.

meaningEn: 'Let's gooo!' — a drawn-out cheer of hype, excitement, or encouragement.
exampleKo: 우리 팀 오늘 경기 이기자! 가즈아!
exampleEn: Let's win today's game, team! Let's gooo!

meaningEn: A great quote or profound words of wisdom, often used playfully.
exampleKo: 와, 방금 네가 한 말 완전 띵언이다. 메모해 놔야겠어.
exampleEn: Wow, what you just said is totally words of wisdom. I should write that down.

meaningEn: A 'god-tier' or exceptionally excellent video game.
exampleKo: 이번에 새로 나온 게임 해봤어? 완전 갓겜이야!
exampleEn: Have you played the new game that just came out? It's a god-tier game!

meaningEn: A sudden hit of harsh reality; a moment of deflating clarity or disillusionment.
exampleKo: 밤새 게임하고 나니 갑자기 현타 와서 현실로 돌아왔어.
exampleEn: After playing games all night, I suddenly had a moment of deflating clarity and came back to reality.

meaningEn: A mental breakdown or meltdown; feeling completely overwhelmed or flustered.
exampleKo: 시험 망쳐서 멘붕 왔어. 오늘 하루 종일 아무것도 못 하겠어.
exampleEn: I messed up my exam, so I'm having a mental breakdown. I can't do anything all day today.

meaningEn: Hopeless; having no solution, no answer, or no redeeming qualities.
exampleKo: 걔 진짜 노답이다. 어떻게 그렇게 행동할 수 있지?
exampleEn: That person is truly hopeless. How can they act like that?

meaningEn: An effortlessly stylish 'done but not done' look, appearing natural yet put-together.
exampleKo: 오늘 꾸안꾸 스타일로 입었는데 괜찮아 보여?
exampleEn: I dressed in an effortlessly stylish 'done but not done' look today, does it look good?

meaningEn: The best photo of one's life; a perfect, once-in-a-lifetime picture.
exampleKo: 와, 여기서 찍은 사진 완전 인생샷 건졌다! 프로필 사진 해야지.
exampleEn: Wow, I got the best photo of my life taken here! I should use it as my profile picture.

meaningEn: A four-cut photo booth picture, a popular type of photo booth for friends.
exampleKo: 오랜만에 친구랑 인생네컷 찍었는데 너무 재밌었어!
exampleEn: It's been a while since I took a four-cut photo booth picture with my friend, it was so much fun!

meaningEn: A hot, trendy spot or popular place; a 'hot place'.
exampleKo: 주말에 새로 생긴 핫플 같이 가볼래?
exampleEn: Want to go to that new trendy spot together this weekend?

meaningEn: A famously delicious restaurant or a popular foodie hotspot.
exampleKo: 이 근처에 엄청 유명한 맛집 있는데, 점심 거기서 먹을까?
exampleEn: There's a super famous foodie hotspot near here, should we have lunch there?

meaningEn: Watching a game or performance live in person, rather than on a screen.
exampleKo: 어제 콘서트 직관 다녀왔는데 진짜 너무 감동적이었어.
exampleEn: I went to watch the concert live yesterday, and it was truly so moving.

meaningEn: Zoning out or spacing out while staring at a fire, finding it relaxing and calming.
exampleKo: 캠핑 가서 불멍 때리니까 너무 힐링된다.
exampleEn: Just zoning out while staring at the fire during camping is so healing.

meaningEn: To space out, zone out, or blank your mind, often without purpose.
exampleKo: 요즘 너무 피곤해서 자꾸 멍때리게 돼. 정신이 없어.
exampleEn: I'm so tired these days that I keep spacing out. My mind is just blank.

meaningEn: Frantic, lightning-fast clicking, often done to secure tickets or limited items online.
exampleKo: 콘서트 티켓 광클 성공했어! 드디어 갈 수 있다니!
exampleEn: I succeeded in frantic clicking for the concert tickets! I can finally go!

meaningEn: 'Like, comment, subscribe, and turn on notifications' — a common call to action for content creators.
exampleKo: 제 채널 영상이 좋았다면 좋댓구알 부탁드립니다!
exampleEn: If you liked my channel's video, please like, comment, subscribe, and turn on notifications!

meaningEn: The best; awesome; fantastic. Used as an intensifier to express strong approval.
exampleKo: 와, 오늘 너 패션 완전 짱인데? 너무 멋지다!
exampleEn: Wow, your fashion today is totally awesome, isn't it? So cool!

meaningEn: Super sweet; awesome; a great, easy deal or situation.
exampleKo: 오늘 시험 완전 개꿀이었다. 벼락치기 안 해도 되겠어.
exampleEn: Today's exam was super easy. I guess I don't even need to cram.

meaningEn: A 'super' or 'ultra' intensifier prefix, meaning extremely or tremendously.
exampleKo: 주말에 본 영화 핵꿀잼이었어. 너도 꼭 봐봐.
exampleEn: The movie I saw this weekend was super fun. You should definitely watch it too.

meaningEn: A 'god-tier' intensifier prefix, used to praise something as exceptional or perfect.
exampleKo: 이번에 출시된 스마트폰 진짜 갓성비 대박이다.
exampleEn: The smartphone that just came out has truly amazing god-tier value for money.
